title: How One Honest Text a Week Changes What a Godly Man Carries Alone
caption:
You weren't built to carry it alone. Scripture doesn't say manage your sin in private, it says confess it to one another so you can be healed. One honest text to one man, sent before Sunday-you shows up with an alibi, does more than another silent week of white-knuckling it.

Save this for the week you need to send it.
